body:
The most significant barrier to your wealth isn’t usually your strategy—it’s your story. We often carry inherited beliefs about what we deserve, how hard we have to work, and whether it is truly "safe" to have more than enough. Purpurite is the stone of psychological breakthrough, acting as a literal "reset button" for the mind. This rare, saturated purple mineral works primarily with the Crown and Third Eye chakras to strip away the mental clutter and "stuck" energy that keeps you playing small.

When you hold or meditate with a Purpurite Point, you are engaging with a frequency of total sovereignty. It encourages you to take full ownership of your reality, helping you to speak your truth and act with a level of confidence that commands respect in your career and business dealings. It is particularly powerful for those who feel overwhelmed by big decisions or find themselves trapped in loops of overthinking. By clearing the "noise," Purpurite allows your intuition to step forward, guiding you toward the specific opportunities, pivots, and investments that are in highest alignment with your future self.

This point is a treasure-hunted find from our recent travels, selected for its deep, iridescent sheen and its ability to hold a sharp, focused intention. Whether you are navigating a major career transition, scaling a business, or simply ready to stop the cycle of self-sabotage, Purpurite provides the mental landscape necessary for a true abundance upgrade. It reminds you that wealth is not just something you work for—it is something you must be mentally prepared to receive.
